derived_b: Derived-metadata interface: final has action=final and answers at TOP LEVEL. Each answer has kind and evidence_id only, for example {"action":"final","answers":[{"kind":"personal_change","evidence_id":"RETURNED_ID"}]}. Select kind/evidence_id pairs from the available_answers catalogue. The identity strings in that same catalogue expose the precise analytical meaning but are not output fields for this interface. Final actions select only intended answers from evidence already returned. Available answers are listed mechanically on each tool result; this catalogue is not a list of what the user requires. Kinds: peer_comparison selects focal/reference window means; personal_change selects only the earlier/recent personal contrast, not a peer answer; assessment_status selects dated assessment records; observation_status selects administrative/recorded states; measurement_limit selects the grade/logging/learning limitation statement. Select at most ten answers resolving to at most six evidence IDs. Do not manually enumerate panels or claims. Do not author support, scope, conclusion, request_map or stopping_status fields. Support and peer/personal scope are derived from the selected kind and validated evidence. The heading is descriptive; no cross-reference conclusion is added. Required layout/context may be supplied with separate provenance, but no missing quantitative answer or analysis is added. Numerical validity does not establish that you selected all requested answers.
binding_c: Explicit-binding interface: final has action=final and answers at TOP LEVEL. Each answer has identity only, for example {"action":"final","answers":[{"identity":"EXACT_RETURNED_IDENTITY"}]}. Copy an exact identity from the available_answers catalogue. The identity spells out kind, person/course, cutoff, feature, and relevant windows/reference. Personal identities have earlier/recent windows and no peer reference. Equivalent personal summaries resolve under checked agreement to a stable returned evidence ID. Unknown or altered identities are rejected; no nearest result is substituted.
